beats.vo_text: Ye kahani kisi social media afwaah par nahi, balki Delhi Ridge Forest ka 14th century Tughlaq Hunting Lodge (Malcha Mahal) par darj hai. Bahar Dhaula Kuan ka traffic daudta hai, lekin jaise hi aap jungle ke andar ISRO satellite station ke paas kadam rakhte hain, mobile network completely dead ho jata hai. Lekin 1993 mein Begum Wilayat Mahal of Awadh, Prince Ali Raza aur Princess Sakina ke sath ek aisi ghatna ghati jisne is poore ilaaqe ki taqdeer badal di.
beats.sound_cue: Distant hollow wind + eerie ambient string drone

beats.vo_text: Jo log yahan se aadhi raat ko guzre hain, unhone bataya ki theek 12 bajte hi... hawa mein heere pisne jaisi karr-karr aawaz aati hai aur 28 Doberman kutton ke bhonkne ki ajeeb goonj sunaayi deti hai jabki wahan koi kutta zinda nahi hai. Mobile phone ka battery percentage achanak zero ho jata hai aur tapman itna girta jaise aap kisi barfili ghaati mein khade hon.

beats.vo_text: Sabse khaufnaak hadsa tab report hua jab 1993 mein Begum ne apne khandaani heere peeskar khudkushi ki thi, unke marne ke baad dono bachhe unki laash ke sath 10 din tak usi bistar par sote rahe! Chashmadeedo ke mutabiq unhone deewar par dekha ki sadiyon purana ek saya bina zameen ko chhue tezi se unki taraf badh raha tha! Unhone cheekh kar kaha: 'Yahan aane wale kisi bhi ajnabi ko zinda wapas nahi jane diya jayega!' — aur unke paas wahan se bhaagne ke siva koi rasta nahi bacha tha!

Aaj tak forensic science aur local prashasan ke paas iska koi jawab nahi hai. Kuch raaz aise hote hain jinhe andhere mein hi dafan rehne dena chahiye.
